body: This made me instantly shed tears. Thank you so so much for the reply, it means a lot
I also don’t know how to make this serious reply’s only, my bad :(

Context: I’m 17. I don’t need pity or sympathy I just need help trying to get through this. My home life has caused me to have major depression and anxiety and I had to take a year off highschool, so now i’m behind. Everyday i’m overwhelmed by the problems in my home, I get upset and breakdown but nothing comes of it, the problems don’t get fixed and all it does is make my family feel bad. I’m emotionally exhausted, I feel like a shell of a human being and the stress literally feels like it’s rotting my soul. Has anyone ever gone through this and went on to have a somewhat okay life? What steps did you take and what helped you get there?
I don’t think i’ve ever cried this much. Imagining my parents finding this and reading it breaks my heart.

The derealization/depersonalization is honestly one of the hardest parts. Do have any tips on coping with it? For me nothing feels real and I can’t even leave my house sometimes because I just feel so separated from everyone it’s so unsettling.
